48/G.goal: Explain how an interactive XR system is developed and delivered, contrasting the traditional interactive-system lifecycle with agile sprint-based development.
48/G.achieves: It gives the learner the foundational process context for XR system implementation, including the stages, trade-offs, and delivery mechanisms they will need to follow the case-study implementation and later optimization topics.

48/O1.goal: Distinguish how a traditional stage-by-stage interactive-system lifecycle and an agile sprint-based process structure the implementation, documentation, feedback, and delivery of an interactive XR system.
48/O1.achieves: It lets the learner understand the development-process choices behind XR implementation and the cost, schedule, documentation, and feedback implications of those choices, supporting the course aim of understanding and implementing an XR system with confidence.
